# quarry — agent guide

<!-- ops:identity start — generated by ops-docs; edit identity.toml -->
One CLI and skills over scientific resources, with domains as lenses
<!-- ops:identity end -->

## Setup

`just setup` runs `uv sync --group dev` behind work-link. Python 3.13 or later,
uv, and just are required. The checkout uses `.githooks/` via
`git config core.hooksPath .githooks`.

## Gates

- `just test-one <pytest args>` runs a path under `tests/`, `path::name`, or `-k expr`.
- `just test-fast` runs the whole small suite; run it before committing. Subprocess CLI
  tests prevent reliable testmon selection; keep the full suite until affected selection is justified.
- `just test` runs the full suite.
- `just check` runs ops-check, ops-docs check, and tasks check.
- There is no CI; the pre-push hook carries the full suite.

Use the just recipes so tools/tt records each run; never call pytest directly.

## Layout

- `src/quarry/`: the Python package.
- `src/quarry/catalog/`: resources and domains. The registry comes from refs.
- `src/quarry/adapters/`: one module per supported resource; `eutils.py` is shared by GEO and PubMed.
- `tests/`: tests; `tests/fixtures/` holds recorded resource responses.
- `tests/recordings/`: scenarios that `just record <resource>` captures.
- `tools/`: timing and gate tools vendored from ops.

## Rules

Tests never reach the network: they replay `tests/fixtures/`, refreshed only by
`just record <resource>`. A live call in a test makes the suite depend on services
that fail (ENA's count endpoint returned 500 during the myeloma survey).

A new command or option is a row in ops `cli.toml` first, then `vendored adopt cli.toml`;
the conformance test fails on any difference.

Catalog owned prefixes must use Bioregistry's canonical spelling. Local-prefix
declarations must be lowercase so validation and owner routing agree, and their patterns
must be in refs' pattern dialect (`[0-9]`, not `\d`); `quarry check` reports one that is not and
startup leaves it out. A scheme several projects share
belongs in refs' shared local schemes, with the catalog only owning the prefix.
